# apple_subscription_introductory_offer (Resource)

Manages one introductory offer of an auto-renewable subscription, in one territory.

An introductory offer is what a new subscriber pays at first — a free trial, a reduced price per period, or a reduced price paid once — before the subscription's own price applies. Apple keeps one record per territory.

Only `end_date` changes in place; every other attribute forces replacement, because Apple's update request carries nothing else.

~> **Use `apple_subscription_introductory_offer_schedule` for more than a handful of territories.** This resource is one `POST` per territory, so a free trial in all 175 storefronts is 175 resources. The schedule writes them in one request. Do not point both at the same subscription: the schedule removes any offer it does not list.

~> **An `apple_subscription_availability` covering the territory has to exist first.** Nothing in an offer references one, so declare the ordering with `depends_on`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

resource "apple_subscription_group" "premium" {
  app_id         = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
  reference_name = "Premium"
}

resource "apple_subscription" "pro_monthly" {
  group_id            = apple_subscription_group.premium.id
  product_id          = "com.example.app.pro.monthly"
  name                = "Pro Monthly"
  subscription_period = "ONE_MONTH"
}

# An offer is for one territory, and the subscription has to be available
# there. Nothing in an offer references the availability, so the dependency is
# declared by hand below.
resource "apple_subscription_availability" "pro_monthly" {
  subscription_id       = apple_subscription.pro_monthly.id
  available_territories = ["USA", "GBR"]
}

# A one-week free trial for new subscribers in the United States. A free trial
# references no price point.
resource "apple_subscription_introductory_offer" "pro_monthly_usa_trial" {
  subscription_id   = apple_subscription.pro_monthly.id
  territory_id      = "USA"
  offer_mode        = "FREE_TRIAL"
  duration          = "ONE_WEEK"
  number_of_periods = 1

  # The one attribute that changes in place: moving or removing the end date
  # updates this offer rather than replacing it.
  end_date = "2027-03-31"

  depends_on = [apple_subscription_availability.pro_monthly]
}

# Three months at a reduced price in the United Kingdom. A paid offer is a
# price point like any other price, read from the subscription's catalogue.
data "apple_subscription_price_points" "gbr_intro" {
  subscription_id = apple_subscription.pro_monthly.id
  territories     = ["GBR"]
  customer_price  = "0.99"
}

resource "apple_subscription_introductory_offer" "pro_monthly_gbr_intro" {
  subscription_id   = apple_subscription.pro_monthly.id
  territory_id      = "GBR"
  offer_mode        = "PAY_AS_YOU_GO"
  duration          = "ONE_MONTH"
  number_of_periods = 3
  price_point_id    = data.apple_subscription_price_points.gbr_intro.price_points[0].id

  depends_on = [apple_subscription_availability.pro_monthly]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (String) How long one offer period lasts: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS` or `ONE_YEAR`. Apple restricts the combinations: for `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` it is the subscription's own period, and it validates the rest itself.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) How many `duration` periods the offer lasts. `1` for `FREE_TRIAL` and `PAY_UP_FRONT`; the number of discounted billing periods for `PAY_AS_YOU_GO`.
- `offer_mode` (String) What the customer pays during the offer: `FREE_TRIAL` (nothing), `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` (a reduced price every billing period for `number_of_periods` periods) or `PAY_UP_FRONT` (a reduced price once, for the whole `duration`).
- `subscription_id` (String) The ID of the `apple_subscription` this offer belongs to.
- `territory_id` (String) The three-letter Apple territory code the offer applies in, for example `USA`, `GBR` or `EGY`. An introductory offer is always for one territory, and a territory holds one introductory offer at a time.

### Optional

- `end_date` (String) The last day the offer is available to new subscribers, as a plain date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form. Omit it for an offer with no end. This is the only attribute Apple allows to change on an existing offer.
- `price_point_id` (String) The price point the customer pays during a `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` or `PAY_UP_FRONT` offer. Required for those modes and rejected for `FREE_TRIAL`. Obtain it from the `apple_subscription_price_points` data source for this subscription and territory.
- `start_date` (String) The first day the offer is available to new subscribers, as a plain date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form. Omit it for an offer that starts immediately; Apple then records the day the offer was created as its start date.

Computed when it is not configured, so a start date Apple fills in is recorded rather than planned away.
- `target_subscription_plan_type` (String) Which plan the offer applies to: `MONTHLY` or `UPFRONT`. Omit it for an ordinary subscription.

Computed when it is not configured, because Apple may report a plan type on an offer that never named one.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the offer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Introductory offers import as "<subscription_id>/<offer_id>".
#
# The subscription ID is required because Apple publishes no GET for a single
# introductory offer: an offer is only reachable through the collection hanging
# off its subscription.
terraform import apple_subscription_introductory_offer.pro_monthly_usa_trial 6739472901/9923456702
```
